comparison.objective: Count six bolts and put exactly half into a cup; candidate fractures and contains four known tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Counting plus ordinary pick-and-place differs from impact tool use, insert alignment, fracture control, and post-fracture search.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly three bolts in the cup and any other count fails; candidate requires all four generated tangs in a tray plus undamaged retained components.
comparison.reason: Container placement is a generic shared endpoint; the record primarily tests numerical reasoning, while the candidate tests mechanical finishing and loss prevention.
